method: Candidates re-extracted from ZA Memo 143 Revision 1 (2025-08-01, supplied by the project owner). Each new candidate was checked against its source chunk by Claude Opus 5.5 (via Claude Code) and independently by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Anthropic API); the source document itself is the official Revision 1. Candidates whose parameter, value and quote are identical to a candidate decided in the 2026-10-15 review carry that decision, because their text did not change.

Second model: Limit applies to a maximum of one detached new-construction ADU per lot (quantity cap); The 800 sq ft figure supersedes local floor area limits such as RFA or HPOZ standards that would otherwise limit the ADU to a smaller size (e.g., 700 sq ft), so it acts as a state-law floor, not a cap on what local rules may allow

Second model: Applies only when there is an existing multifamily dwelling building(s) on the Lot; the counting rule is for establishing the cap on detached ADUs under Subparagraph (4); Purpose of the count: the number of detached ADUs is capped at eight and may not exceed the number of existing units
